meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE whenever a task needs a commit or git-history investigation. Covers atomic commits, staging, commit-message style, rebase, squash, fixup/autosquash, blame, bisect, reflog, git log -S/-G, and questions like who wrote this or when was this added. Do not use for ordinary code edits unless the user asks for git work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交与历史，自动生成规范提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要规范提交或排查 Git 历史
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits and history with automated commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to make clean commits or investigate Git history

howto.what: 当任务涉及 Git 提交或历史调查时，Claude 会先判断请求类型（提交、改写历史、查历史、看状态），然后按类型谨慎操作：只提交你指定的改动，不碰无关文件；查历史时用对应 git 命令并附上证据。
howto.when: 当任务需要提交代码、调查 Git 历史，或改写历史（如 rebase、squash）时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这几个文件的改动分成两次提交
say.note: 会按文件分组生成两个 commit

say.text: 查一下这行代码是谁最后改的
say.note: 用 git blame 定位并给出证据

say.text: 把最近三个提交合并成一个
say.note: 执行 rebase squash 并展示新日志

howto.what_en: Claude classifies Git tasks (commit, rebase, history, status), commits only requested changes, preserves unrelated dirty work, and answers history questions with cited git evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggered whenever a task needs a commit or Git-history investigation, including rebase, squash, blame, bisect, reflog, and similar operations.

say_en.text: Split these file changes into two separate commits
Find who last changed this line
say_en.note: Uses git blame and cites evidence

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits into one
say_en.note: Rebases with autosquash and shows new log
